name: ServiceM8
description: ServiceM8 is the app for trade contractors & home service professionals, with everything in one place to help you effortlessly manage your jobs, technicians & clients — job cards, scheduling, time tracking, staff GPS, client emails & SMS, job photos, online bookings, quotes, invoices, payments & more. ServiceM8 helps you cut paperwork, get more jobs done & provide amazing customer service.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ServiceM8 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ServiceM8 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.servicem8.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ServiceM8 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ServiceM8 lists 24 MCP tools, including add_job_note, change_job_status, compose_email_message, compose_sms_message, create_job, create_job_activity, create_job_allocation, fetch, get_availability, get_job_details, get_job_diary, and get_jobs_in_filter.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ServiceM8?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ServiceM8 in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
ServiceM8 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ServiceM8 is developed by ServiceM8. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
